_about: How many units of each product this shelf sells a day, from official Greek household purchases (ELSTAT, Household Budget Survey 2025, table 2.00, data/shelf/elstat_hbs_2025.csv). Used by scripts/calibrate_sales.py. Every number not from ELSTAT is an assumption and says so.
households_source: assumption: households that shop at a mid-sized neighbourhood supermarket
store_share_source: assumption: share of those households' purchases of the category made in this store
split: equal grams across the products of a category on the shelf, unless catalog.csv has a sales_weight column

Ελαιόλαδο.shelf_share_source: assumption: 1L bottles on this shelf vs all olive oil the store sells (tins, other aisles)

Ελιές.shelf_share_source: assumption: jars here vs the deli counter

Μέλι.shelf_share_source: assumption: ELSTAT groups honey with molasses and glucose

Ζυμαρικά.shelf_share_source: assumption: traditional pasta here vs the pasta aisle

Μπαχαρικά.shelf_share_source: assumption: one pack of bay leaves vs every spice the store sells

Αλλαντικά.shelf_share_source: assumption: packed village sausages here vs the chilled cabinet

categories._no_elstat_item: Ταχίνι: ELSTAT has no separate item. daily_units in catalog.csv is an assumption of the same order as olives and honey, and is marked as such
